ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle, with point O labeled inside the circle and serving as the center; line segments are drawn from O to A and B on the circumference, respectively, representing radii OA and OB. The radius length is labeled 3 cm in the figure, and the central angle ∠AOB is labeled 45°. Reasoning: What is required is the length of minor arc AB. The arc length formula is s = (θ/360°)·2πr. Substituting θ = 45° and r = 3 cm gives s = (45/360)·2π·3 = (1/8)·6π = 0.75π ≈ 2.356. Rounded to the hundredths place, it is 2.36 cm.
